sources.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model

sources.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models

candidates.name: FlashAttention

uncertainRelationships.reason: They share a KV-cache efficiency objective, but MLA is not established as a direct successor to GQA; retain only a reciprocal related edge.
Both concern factual-knowledge control, but weight editing and pretraining-time knowledge externalization are distinct enough that a cross-area edge may mislead.
FlashAttention can be used inside multimodal systems, but that implementation-level fact does not define a durable conceptual relationship between the two topics.
